timely.label: 20 Years of Taylor
timely.line: Twenty years ago this week, Taylor Swift released her very first album, Taylor Swift, the 2006 debut that made her a rising star in country music.

timely.label: Reba Is Back
timely.line: Reba McEntire's NBC sitcom Happy's Place returns for season three, with Reba as Bobbie, who inherits her dad's Tennessee tavern, reunited with Melissa Peterman.

timely.label: New NBC Sitcom
timely.line: NBC's new sitcom Newlyweds stars Tea Leoni and Tim Daly as a free spirit and a buttoned-up professor who marry on impulse, Fridays at 8:30 Eastern.

timely.label: Matthew Perry Doc
timely.line: Netflix's three-part documentary The One About Matthew Perry looks back at the Friends star's life and his comedy legacy as Chandler Bing.

timely.label: Family Movie
timely.line: The stop-motion family fantasy Wildwood, adapted from the children's novel, follows a girl into a secret enchanted forest to save her baby brother, with Mahershala Ali and Angela Bassett.

timely.label: New on Netflix
timely.line: Netflix's new comedy Minimum Wage follows a crew of teenage workers at a chaotic local pizza shop, in short 12-minute episodes with a guest spot from Randall Park.

johnsons.label: Outdoors
johnsons.line: Missouri Conservation is asking southwest Missouri deer hunters to get their deer sampled for chronic wasting disease all season, at MDC offices, meat processors, taxidermists and freezer drops.

johnsons.label: Outdoors
johnsons.line: Busch Shooting Range is holding a Field to Freezer class on October 31 to teach deer hunters how to handle and prepare their deer right after the harvest.

johnsons.label: Outdoors
johnsons.line: Missouri Conservation is hosting a free class in Hannibal on November 10 showing hunters how to process a deer into freezer-ready venison.

johnsons.label: Outdoors
johnsons.line: Missouri Conservation has a free milkweed event in Columbia on November 7, and everyone goes home with milkweed seed of their own to plant.

johnsons.label: Outdoors
johnsons.line: Seven-year-old Arizona angler Liam Hellum caught his age, landing and releasing a personal-best 7.1-pound largemouth bass.

johnsons.label: Family
johnsons.line: Romorgniz is recalling six-drawer dressers because they can tip over and trap kids if not anchored to the wall, and they fail the federal safety standard.

johnsons.label: Family
johnsons.line: The Conqueror is recalling Avengers medals because their strong magnets can come loose, and swallowed magnets are a deadly danger to children.

johnsons.label: Family
johnsons.line: Primark is recalling 101 Dalmatians faux leather children's coin purses because they contain high levels of phthalates, which can be harmful if kids chew on them.

johnsons.label: Family
johnsons.line: A Reddit dad blew his 7-year-old's mind with this trick for 11 plus 7: take the 1 off the 11, add it to the 7 to make 8, then add that to 10 for 18.

johnsons.label: Cooking
johnsons.line: Skinnytaste has an easy high-protein fall dinner: Crockpot Chicken with Apples, a sweet-and-savory twist on Chicken Normandy served over mashed potatoes.

johnsons.label: Cooking
johnsons.line: Budget Bytes has a cozy Italian Wedding Soup with tender meatballs, vegetables and pasta in chicken broth, perfect for a chilly fall weeknight.

johnsons.label: Cooking
johnsons.line: Skinnytaste posted a free seven-day high-protein meal plan with breakfast, lunch and dinner ideas plus a ready-made shopping list.

johnsons.label: Cooking
johnsons.line: A Reddit meal prepper shared a healthier nacho beef bowl with a lime slaw on the side that makes four servings for the week.

johnsons.label: Life
johnsons.line: Stop raking your leaves: turf scientists say bagging them is mostly wasted work and may actually shortchange your grass.

johnsons.label: Life
johnsons.line: Walmart scam victims are getting refund checks averaging 150 dollars, so don't toss yours, but watch out because fake checks are going around too.

johnsons.label: Life
johnsons.line: Scammers are cashing in on the rush for Apple's new foldable iPhone Duo with fake preorder scams, so be careful where you order one.

johnsons.label: Life
johnsons.line: A Reddit poster says snipping open an empty toothpaste tube with scissors gets at least five more brushings out of it.

johnsons.label: Life
johnsons.line: A Reddit poster scored the most comfortable couch they've ever laid on for 70 dollars at a local thrift store that sells furniture dirt cheap.
